info.title: OmniChat API
info.description:
OmniChat is a desktop-first, self-hostable AI chat workspace with BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) support. This API covers conversations, messages, projects, provider credentials, user preferences, streaming chat and operational endpoints.

Every path below is relative to the `/api` base in `servers`. Authentication is the NextAuth session cookie, enforced by root middleware for all paths except `/health` and the exact `/metrics` (which is gated by its bearer token instead) and the `/auth/*` namespace. Mutations with a JSON body additionally require a same-origin `Origin`/`Referer` (403), a JSON content type (415), and a resolvable canonical origin (503 when `APP_ORIGIN`/`NEXTAUTH_URL` are unset in production).

get.description: Readiness probe for monitors and container healthchecks; exempt from the session middleware. Probes both the database and the encryption secret.

200.description: Application is healthy (database up and encryption configured).

503.description: Not ready. `degraded` means the database answers but the vault key is missing or shorter than 32 characters; `unhealthy` means the database probe failed. Both return 503 so strict probes treat the instance as down.

get.description: Prometheus text exposition. Deliberately exempt from the session middleware so a scraper can reach it; the bearer token is therefore the ONLY gate. Fails closed: with `METRICS_TOKEN` unset in production, and on any token mismatch, the response is 404 with an empty body so the surface is not advertised. With the token unset outside production the endpoint is open for local debugging.

404.description: Unauthorized for this endpoint, or disabled because METRICS_TOKEN is unset in production. Empty body; 404 rather than 401/403 by design.

get.summary: List providers with the caller's key status
get.description: The full provider registry, annotated with whether the authenticated user has stored a key for each provider.

post.description: Validates the request, decrypts the stored provider key server-side, calls the provider and streams the reply as a plain-text token stream (not JSON). The user message is persisted BEFORE the provider is called, the assistant reply and `Conversation.updatedAt` are written when the stream finishes, and a stopped stream still stores the partial reply; a turn is never persisted twice. Prompt history is rebuilt from the database plus the incoming user message - the client transcript is not trusted. `privateMode` skips all persistence. Never echoes the API key.

X-Conversation-Id.description: Conversation the turn belongs to. Absent when privateMode is true.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, schema violation, a transcript whose last message is not from the user, or no stored key for the provider.

example.error: Last message must be from the user

get.description: Cursor-paginated by (updatedAt, id), newest first. Each item carries at most its last message.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, clamped to 1-100 out of range rather than rejected.

parameters.name: cursorId
parameters.description: Conversation id from a previous nextCursor.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Pass the literal string `true` to list archived conversations only.

post.description: providerId and modelId are required; a project, when given, is ownership-checked.

404.description: projectId refers to a project the caller does not own.

delete.summary: Delete every conversation of the caller
delete.description: Bulk delete guarded by CSRF; cascades to messages. Idempotent - an empty result returns deletedCount 0.

get.summary: Get one conversation with its transcript

200.description: Conversation including all messages in createdAt order.

404.description: Unknown id, or owned by another user (same response, no enumeration).

patch.description: Partial update. `archived: true` sets archivedAt, `false` clears it. Model changes are not part of this contract. `folderId` is stored but not ownership-validated: there is no Folder entity, so it is a free-form label.

get.description: The only route family that returns the { data: ... } envelope; every other route returns a bare object.

post.description: Rate limited: 30 writes per minute per authenticated user.

400.description: Schema violation, or the (userId, name) unique pair already exists.

delete.description: Conversations are kept; their projectId is nulled.

404.description: Not found or not owned; an ownership failure is reported as 404, never 403, to avoid confirming other users' ids.

get.description: Ciphertext and plaintext are never returned; only a hint.

post.description: Validated against the provider before storage unless validate=false. The key is encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a PBKDF2-derived key (600,000 iterations, per-encryption salt) and only the ciphertext and a hint are persisted. Rate limited: 10 requests per minute per authenticated user.

400.description: Schema violation, unknown provider, or provider rejected the key.

delete.summary: Delete the stored key for one provider

200.description: Preferences, or null when the user has never saved any.

patch.description: Partial upsert; unspecified fields keep their current value, and a first write applies defaults.

get.description: Catch-all mounted from Auth.js: /auth/signin, /auth/callback/{provider}, /auth/session, /auth/verify-request, /auth/signout. Not a literal route; concrete sub-paths are owned by the Auth.js handlers and may change with the dependency version.

200.description: Varies by sub-path (session JSON, an HTML page, or a form POST body).

302.description: Redirect during the OAuth dance or after sign-out.

post.description: Sign-in and sign-out submissions, including the credentials form.

302.description: Redirect to the callback or post-signin URL.

post.summary: Register an account and send the verification mail
post.description: Registered under /api/auth/* and therefore outside the session middleware. Answered only when EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED=true; otherwise 404. Rate limited per IP (10/hour) and per normalized address (3/hour). Passwords must be 8+ characters (72-byte cap) with upper, lower and a digit; the schema is strict, so unknown fields are rejected.

202.description: Accepted. The same generic answer is returned whether or not the address was newly created, to prevent account enumeration.

example.message: If verification is needed, check your email for instructions.

404.description: Email verification is not enabled (EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED is not `true`).

429.description: Send quota exhausted. Only Retry-After is attached here, not the X-RateLimit-* trio.

503.description: SMTP configuration invalid or the rate-limit backend is unavailable.

post.description: Same 404/403/413/415/429/503 envelope as /auth/register; the body is only an email address.

202.description: Accepted, phrased identically whether or not the address exists.

503.description: SMTP configuration invalid or the rate-limit backend is unavailable.

post.description: Confirmation happens on POST so that mail scanners prefetching a GET link cannot consume the token. The token is 64 hex characters, expires after 30 minutes and is consumed atomically, so a replay fails.

example.message: Email verified. You can now sign in.

400.description: Unknown, expired, already-consumed or mismatched token, or a schema violation.

429.description: Verification attempt quota exhausted (30/15min per IP, 10/15min per address); Retry-After only.

503.description: SMTP configuration invalid or the rate-limit backend is unavailable.

sessionAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
sessionAuth.description: NextAuth session cookie. Hosted deployments additionally require the account's email to be verified when EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED=true.

metricsToken.description: Value of METRICS_TOKEN, compared in constant time. The only gate on /metrics, which is exempt from the session middleware.

Unauthorized.description: No session. The root middleware answers 401 for /api paths instead of redirecting to /login.

ForbiddenOrigin.description: CSRF rejection: the Origin/Referer is missing, opaque or foreign to APP_ORIGIN.

UnsupportedType.description: The mutation requires a JSON content type.

RateLimitedChat.description: Quota exhausted (chat: 60/min per user, API keys: 10/min per user).

retryAfter.description: Same value as Retry-After, in the body.

BackendUnavailable.description: Fail-closed: the distributed rate-limit backend was configured but is unreachable, so the request is refused rather than silently unlimited. Also returned when no canonical origin can be resolved for CSRF in production.

InternalError.description: Sanitized failure. The underlying error is logged server-side and never returned to the client.

example.error: An error occurred while processing your request

details.description: Zod issues for the failed schema.

status.description: healthy = 200; degraded (database up, vault key unusable) and unhealthy (database down) both = 503.

encryption.description: up when ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY is set and at least 32 characters.

MessageRole.description: Persisted from server-side literals; a client-supplied role is never trusted.

folderId.description: Stored column with no Folder entity behind it: a free-form label, not ownership-validated.

updatedAt.description: Touched on every completed chat turn, which is what keeps list recency and cursors correct.

lastMessage.description: At most the newest message, from the list query.

messages.description: Whole transcript, oldest first. Not paginated.

keyHint.description: Last four characters only. Never the key or the ciphertext.

isValid.description: Means "confirmed valid with the provider". A key stored with validate=false is intentionally false, not a failure; a decrypt failure also flips it to false.

PreferencesUpdate.description: Every field optional; the PATCH is a partial upsert.

hasKey.description: Whether the caller has stored a key for this provider.

messages.description: Client transcript. Its last entry must be from the user, otherwise 400. Only used for continuity; the prompt actually sent is rebuilt from the database.

privateMode.description: When true nothing is persisted and no X-Conversation-Id is returned.

projectId.description: Applied when this request creates the conversation.

folderId.description: Applied when this request creates the conversation.

UpdateConversationRequest.description: Model changes are not part of this contract, and the retired isPinned field is no longer accepted.

archived.description: Maps to archivedAt: true stamps it, false clears it.

validate.description: When false the key is stored with isValid=false, meaning "not yet confirmed with the provider".
